notes.title: Transport Tycoon Deluxe inspired game OpenTTD has a new release coming
notes.notes: OpenTTD is a free and open source sim based on the classic Transport Tycoon Deluxe, and the team have announced a new release is coming with a first Beta.Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/11/transport-tycoon-deluxe-inspired-game-openttd-has-a-new-release-coming

notes.title: OpenTTD gets a first 12.0 version Beta to make playing with others easier
notes.notes: After the release of OpenTTD on Steam recently, the popularity of the game got a healthy boost but it came with a lot of feedback about some parts that could be improved so this is the first step with OpenTTD 12.0 Beta 1.Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/08/openttd-gets-a-first-120-version-beta-to-make-playing-with-others-easier
